Load configuration files
- location of model drivers, rds files (containing models), tables of parameter estimates and performance metrics, and figures. 
```{r}
read_properties <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  lines <- lines[grepl("=", lines)]  # only keep lines with key-value pairs
  key_vals <- strsplit(lines, "=")
  props <- setNames(
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 2)),
    trimws(sapply(key_vals, `[`, 1))
  )
  return(props)
}

# *** paleo_config.properties must be in Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026
#location of this script:
current_path <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
#get path to this project
base_path <- sub("(.*Paleo_Lightning_Fire_Uden_2026).*", "\\1", current_path)
#open 
config_file_path <- file.path(base_path, "paleo_config.properties")

config <- read_properties(config_file_path)

# Extract values from config
drivers_root <- config[["drivers_root"]]
rds_root <- config[["rds_root"]]
table_root <- config[["table_root"]]
predictions_root <- config[["predictions_root"]]
mu_sigma_root <- config[["mu_sigma_root"]]
performance_root <- config[["performance_root"]]
figure_root <- config[["figure_root"]]
fire_data_root <- config[["fire_data_root"]]
paleoclimate_data_root <- config[["paleoclimate_data_root"]]
era5_data_root <- config[["era5_data_root"]]

rds_root <- file.path(rds_root, "Burned_Area/redo")

```

```{r}
df <- read.csv(file.path(drivers_root, "burned_area_jja_2002_2011_new.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("X"))

df <- df %>% mutate(
  road_proximity_binary  = if_else(dist_road  >= 30, 0, 1),
  urban_proximity_binary = if_else(dist_urban >= 40, 0, 1),
  river_proximity_binary = if_else(dist_river >= 30, 0, 1)
)
nrow(df)
df <- na.omit(df)
nrow(df)

# read in rows with fire count exceeding strike count and compare with burned area
null_rows <- read.csv(file.path(drivers_root, "null_ignition_rows_training_data_2002-2011.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-X)

null_rows <- null_rows %>%
  dplyr::select(year, lat, lon, month, fire_count) %>%
  rename(fire_count_null = fire_count) %>%
  mutate(null_row = 1)

df_nulls <- df %>%
  full_join(null_rows, by = c("lon", "lat", "year", "month")) %>%
  mutate(null_row = replace_na(null_row, 0))

filter(df_nulls, null_row == 1) %>%
  group_by(year, month, lat, lon) %>%
  summarise(total_burned_area = sum(burned_area_km2_total), n_fires = n(), .groups = "drop")

#these null rows need to be dropped. 

df_nulls <- filter(df_nulls, null_row == 0) 
summary(df_nulls$burned_area_km2_total)

df <- df_nulls
```
```{r}
# 1. Recreate the EXACT same df that was originally split
# all training sets used the same seed, just need to make sure to use a
# training set that includes month (ie. not lightning strike rate drivers)
df_train <- read.csv(file.path(drivers_root, "lightning_ignition_jja_2002_2011_new.csv"))

sample_size <- floor(0.8 * nrow(df_train))
set.seed(123)
train_index <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df_train)), size = sample_size)

# 2. Extract identifying keys, not the data itself
train_keys <- unique(df_train[train_index, c("lat", "lon", "year", "month")])
test_keys  <- unique(df_train[-train_index, c("lat", "lon", "year", "month")])

setDT(train_keys); setDT(test_keys)
train_keys[, split := "train"]
test_keys[,  split := "test"]
split_lookup <- rbind(train_keys, test_keys)

df <- df %>%
  left_join(split_lookup, by = c("lat", "lon", "year", "month"))

# Confirm every fire successfully matched a split label -- any NA here
# means some fires are being silently dropped from both train and test
cat(sprintf("Fires with no split match: %d of %d\n", sum(is.na(df$split)), nrow(df)))

train <- df %>% filter(split == "train")
test  <- df %>% filter(split == "test")

# Sanity check: train + test should account for every row (given the check above)
nrow(train) + nrow(test) == nrow(df)
```


```{r}
library(rstan)
library(dplyr)

#read in the mixture model
mixture_obj  <- readRDS(file.path(rds_root, "m3_bayes_mixture_custom.rds"))

#Reload the raw test-set predictors (same object the training
# script used) and the burned-area mu/sigma standardization table ----
# EDIT this path to wherever your training script's `test` object was saved
# (or re-run the same train/test split + predictor prep from that script
# if it wasn't separately exported)

burned_area_mu_sigma <- read.csv(file.path(mu_sigma_root, "mu_sigma_burned_area_predictors.csv"))

get_mu    <- function(var) burned_area_mu_sigma$mu[burned_area_mu_sigma$var == var]
get_sigma <- function(var) burned_area_mu_sigma$sigma[burned_area_mu_sigma$var == var]

preds_classifier <- mixture_obj$preds_classifier   # c("urban_proximity_binary","rh","tair","precip","tair_5y")
preds_extreme    <- mixture_obj$preds_extreme      # c("U","tair")
preds_typical    <- mixture_obj$preds_typical      # c("urban_proximity_binary","tair_2m","tair")

test_scaled <- test %>%
  mutate(
    rh      = (rh      - get_mu("rh"))      / get_sigma("rh"),
    tair    = (tair    - get_mu("tair"))    / get_sigma("tair"),
    precip  = (precip  - get_mu("precip"))  / get_sigma("precip"),
    tair_2m = (tair_2m - get_mu("tair_2m")) / get_sigma("tair_2m"),
    tair_5y = (tair_5y - get_mu("tair_5y")) / get_sigma("tair_5y"),
    U       = (U       - get_mu("U"))       / get_sigma("U")
    # urban_proximity_binary is a 0/1 flag -- not standardized, matching
    # how the unified pipeline treats it
  )

X_test_clf <- as.matrix(test_scaled[, preds_classifier])
X_test_ext <- as.matrix(test_scaled[, preds_extreme])
X_test_typ <- as.matrix(test_scaled[, preds_typical])

# ---- 2. Extract posterior draws and rebuild the SAME per-draw blend the
# training script used internally (expectation blend, not a stochastic
# is_extreme/rgamma sample) -- this keeps the new per-draw table
# consistent with the p_hat/p_low/p_high already saved in mixture_obj ----
post_logit   <- rstan::extract(mixture_obj$fit_logit)
post_extreme <- rstan::extract(mixture_obj$fit_extreme)
post_normal  <- rstan::extract(mixture_obj$fit_normal)

N_DRAWS <- 500
n_avail <- min(length(post_logit$alpha), length(post_extreme$alpha), length(post_normal$alpha))
if (N_DRAWS > n_avail) {
  warning(sprintf("Only %d posterior draws available; using all of them instead of %d.", n_avail, N_DRAWS))
  N_DRAWS <- n_avail
}
draw_idx <- sample(n_avail, N_DRAWS)

pred_draws <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(test_scaled), ncol = N_DRAWS)

for (i in seq_len(N_DRAWS)) {
  d <- draw_idx[i]
  p_ext_d  <- plogis(post_logit$alpha[d]   + X_test_clf %*% post_logit$beta[d, ])
  mu_ext_d <- exp(post_extreme$alpha[d]    + X_test_ext %*% post_extreme$beta[d, ])
  mu_typ_d <- exp(post_normal$alpha[d]     + X_test_typ %*% post_normal$beta[d, ])
  pred_draws[, i] <- p_ext_d * mu_ext_d + (1 - p_ext_d) * mu_typ_d
}

# ---- 3. Long-format table: one row per fire per draw, ready for the same
# per-draw metric functions used elsewhere (compute_overall, compute_sscore) ----
ba_model_draws <- data.table(
  draw_id = rep(seq_len(N_DRAWS), each = nrow(test_scaled)),
  lat  = rep(test$lat,  N_DRAWS),
  lon  = rep(test$lon,  N_DRAWS),
  year = rep(test$year, N_DRAWS),
  burned_area_km2_total = rep(test$burned_area_km2_total, N_DRAWS),
  burned_area_pred      = as.vector(pred_draws)
)

# Sanity check: per-draw mean should be close to (not identical to) the
# saved p_hat median, and draw-to-draw spread should roughly match the
# already-saved pred_low/pred_high interval
ba_model_draws[, .(mean_pred = mean(burned_area_pred)), by = draw_id][, summary(mean_pred)]
quantile(rowMeans(pred_draws), c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
```

```{r}
saveRDS(ba_model_draws, file.path(rds_root, "ba_model_500_draws_test.rds"))
```
